data.one_liner: PEM encoding and decoding of textual keys and certificates following RFC 7468.
data.what_it_does: Encodes and decodes PEM textual key formats and certificate chains. Supports both lax and strict modes, handling extra whitespace and surrounding text during parsing.
use_when: You need to parse PEM-encoded private or public keys in Dart
You need to generate strict-mode PEM strings from key data bytes
You are working with concatenated PEM blocks like certificate chains
avoid_when: You need strict validation that distinguishes malformed PEM blocks from ignored surrounding text
strengths: Supports both lax and strict decoding modes
Handles certificate chains with concatenated PEM blocks
weaknesses: Decoding methods ignore surrounding text, meaning malformed PEM blocks do not throw specific exceptions
